mode: built-in imagegen; edits using actual scene and character references

prompts.name: keepers initial style refinement
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the first image is the existing 4x4 human animation atlas; keep its four-row/four-column registration, two character designs and the exact logical pose order. Supporting visual style reference: the second image is the actual coastal background in which these people will live. The previous atlas looks like a sharp dark-outlined anime sticker pasted onto this nuanced painted scene. REDRAW every pose in the SAME fine painterly pixel technique, tiny broken color edges, nuanced low-contrast dithered texture, matte fabric and wood/skin color shading as the coastal buildings and flower beds. Remove the thick near-black comic contour and glossy oversized eye highlights. Edge colors must be borrowed from the character's local brown, ochre, muted teal or slate shadows; no dark uniform external stroke, no white/red fringe, no neon highlights. This is detailed hand-painted small-pixel game scenery, NOT low-resolution 8-bit icons, not a soft blurred sticker, not a vector illustration. Keep the straw hat, teal band, brown hair, pale ivory shirt, muted denim overalls, tiny simple dot eyes, brown boots and small garden gloves; the diver has the same muted teal outfit, ochre trims and round goggles. Heads should remain cute but modest, reducing the old exaggerated shiny anime eyes. Soft warm light from upper left, subtle reflected cool shade from lower right, lighting values appropriate to the background. Production atlas: square canvas, exactly 4 equal square columns x 4 equal square rows, no gaps or grid lines. Row1 gardener calm idle / small blink / idle / idle; Row2 gardener small walking poses facing right, feet registered at the same floor baseline; Row3 diver idle / blink / idle / idle; Row4 same diver low wave / raised hand / middle wave / hand lowering. In EVERY tile, whole character occupies approximately the central 66 percent width and 78 percent height; center stays at 50% width and the ground-contact baseline at 86% tile height. Every extremity stays inside the tile. Transparent background: only the painted people, absolutely no scenery, captions, frames, solid matte, speech bubbles or cast shadow. Do not include any background reference pixels. The result must feel like these characters were painted by the same artist, at the same fine detail scale, as the attached environment.

prompts.name: keepers padding follow-up
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, production framing correction only. Edit the attached transparent square four-column/four-row character atlas. Preserve its new fine painted pixel texture, all character identities, colors and sixteen pose order exactly; do NOT go back to thick black contours. Correct its major framing defect: figures currently touch tile boundaries, including the upper hats and the lower boots. The output must have EXACTLY four columns and four rows of equal SQUARE transparent tiles with no gaps, on one square canvas. In each tile scale and reposition the existing whole figure so it occupies at most 66% of the tile WIDTH and 74% of its HEIGHT. The figure center must be at 50% tile width, its lowest boot at 86% tile height, leaving 14% truly transparent margin below the feet and at least 12% margin above every hat. Leave at least 15% transparent margin at left and right. This padding is MANDATORY in every cell, not just the outer perimeter. Uniform baselines, body scale and registration within each row. No hands, hats, bags or feet may enter an adjacent tile. Entire first-row hats and last-row boots must be visible. Repair edges as colored fine brush pixels from the local garment, not pure black borders or bright red halos. GENUINE ALPHA transparency everywhere outside the sixteen isolated figures, including all cell padding; no grid, shadow, scenery, text or cell markers. Keep the selected hand-painted pixel art otherwise unchanged. This is a web animation atlas and exact cell separation is more important than filling the canvas.

prompts.name: companions style refinement
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept / scene-coherent sprite creation. Image 1 is the current orange-white sleeping cat and blue bird identity reference; image 2 supplies duck and butterfly identity; image 3 is the ACTUAL coastal environment; image 4 is the ACTUAL painted study-room environment. Create a NEW transparent four-column/four-row SQUARE character atlas with exactly sixteen poses and equal square cells. The animals must look painted by the SAME artist and at the SAME delicate pixel-brush detail scale as the coastal flowers, roof tiles and study-room wood. Replace the old thick black sticker outlines, oversaturated flat blue and cream blocks, glossy cartoon eyes with thin broken locally colored edges, finely shaded fur/feathers, tiny simple natural dark eyes and muted warm-ivory highlights. No pure-black uniform outside stroke, red/white halos, vector curves, icon-like silhouettes, smooth blur or 8-bit enlargement. Preserve the friendly reference identities and their general colors. Matte painted miniatures with subtle warm upper-left light and cool reflected shading. Layout: exactly four equally spaced square cells in each of four rows, no grid lines/gaps. Row1 SAME orange-white cat lying comfortably on belly: sleepy / open-eye blink / small tail-tip lift / sleepy. Row2 SAME small blue bird with cream breast, orange beak/feet and a tiny warm orange flower held left: perched wings down / partial wing raise / delighted raised wings / wings lowering. Row3 SAME ivory duck, orange beak, sitting in water: four subtly different paddling/body/wing poses; keep water surface out of artwork. Row4 SAME small warm amber butterfly: wings spread / half folded / narrow folded / half spread. EVERY figure, including tails and raised wings, must remain INSIDE its own cell, centered at 50% cell width; use at most 68% cell width and 68% cell height, with a whole-cell 16% true transparent guard margin. Cat should naturally be low and wide, bird should have believable small-bird proportions rather than a round flat mascot. No feet outside cells. GENUINE alpha transparency, nothing else in the image. No ground shadow, solid matte, frames, background, labels, speech bubbles, plants or letters. Fine painterly pixel detail coherent with the attached actual scene is the main goal.
